newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eutelsat buys TDF satellite from Fr. Telecom unit.
newsitem.headline: Eutelsat buys TDF satellite from Fr. Telecom unit.

text.p: The international satellite organisation Eutelsat said on Monday it had bought the TDF2 satelite from Telediffusion de France, a unit of France Telecom.
A spokeswoman for Eutelsat declined to comment on the price.
TDF2 will move to a position of 36 degrees East, from 19 degrees West, to provide capacity for a private Russian television broadcaster who will transmit programmes over European Russia.
TDF2 will be joined next year at that position by Eutelsat II-F2 and SESAT.
TDF2 became operational in mid-1990 and is expected to remain in service until 1999.
TDF2 joins the eight satellites already operated by Eutelsat. Seven new satellites are under construction.
